name: dotnet-csharpier
description: Automatic CSharpier formatting for C# files after Claude writes or edits them

csharpier.note: CSharpier reads an unknown option as a path, so a flag it does not know fails every run with 'no file or directory found at --flag' instead of erroring clearly. The errorsAsWarnings option was renamed between 1.2.6 and 1.3.0, and both versions are in the wild, so format-csharp.sh picks whichever name the installed CLI lists in 'format --help' rather than hardcoding one.
